## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one concern
- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behaviour, and the full suite passes locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, docstrings, TEMPLATE.md) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys, or customer data in the diff
- [ ] Any new GitHub Action is pinned to a full commit SHA
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out below
